subject.title: feat: add Fedora/RHEL-family platform support with rootless Podman

question: Should this repository formally support Fedora/RHEL-family hosts through a rootless Podman Quadlet and firewalld path alongside the existing Debian/Ubuntu Docker/UFW installer?
rationale: This is a large new operating-system and runtime support contract, not a repair to an established behavior; correctness checks cannot determine the project’s desired long-term support and security-maintenance burden.

options.title: Sponsor dual-platform support
options.body: Accept rootless Podman/firewalld as a supported contract, contingent on contributor-provided real disposable-host proof for both platform families.

options.title: Retain Debian/Ubuntu scope
options.body: Decline the new supported runtime path and ask for any portable documentation or preparatory work to be split from the platform expansion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor dual-platform support
recommendation.body: Accept rootless Podman/firewalld as a supported contract, contingent on contributor-provided real disposable-host proof for both platform families.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main-branch firewall and Tailscale work makes this the best available routing candidate for the runtime/firewall support decision.
